nehemiah.11.p1.b1.text: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots …

nehemiah.11.p1.b2.text: … to bring one out of ten to live in the holy city of Jerusalem, while the remaining nine were to dwell in their own towns.

nehemiah.11.p1.b3.text: And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

nehemiah.11.p2.b1.text: … These are the heads of the provinces who settled in Jerusalem. …

nehemiah.11.p2.b2.text: The descendants of Perez who settled in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of valor.

nehemiah.11.p2.b3.text: Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who led in thanksgiving and prayer …

nehemiah.11.p2.b4.text: For there was a command from the king concerning the singers, an ordinance regulating their daily activities.

nehemiah.11.p3.b1.text: … So they settled from Beersheba all the way to the Valley of Hinnom.

nehemiah.11.p3.b2.text: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel, and their villages …

nehemiah.11.p3.b3.text: The descendants of Benjamin from Geba lived in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel with its villages …
